title: Sheikh Hasina Plans to Return to Bangladesh: Lockdown Violence, Garment Strikes and India's Dilemma
description_html:
Sheikh Hasina's planned return has put Bangladesh on edge. Hasina says she will come back in December after a death sentence in absentia. We explain the Awami League's lockdown call, the reported bomb blasts and arson, the government's response under Prime Minister Tarique Rahman, the garment-worker protests, and why New Delhi faces a difficult question. Claims about the plan are as reported and not verified by us.

Sources: Bangladeshi and international media reports, statements from the Awami League and Bangladesh's authorities, and news agencies. Claims labelled as reported or alleged are not verified by us.
